scientific_role: small public-data known-truth development holdout for source-backed structural ranking; not confirmation

explicitly_deferred_eligible_pairs.reason: The current frozen coastal component semantics require a native WorldCover land-component representation. Broad fixed-region sparse component semantics are not qualified in v1; do not substitute a coarser component definition after the opened CIR08 coastal result.

candidate_frame.grid_spacing_rationale: For the preregistered 5-km primary recovery radius, an unmasked square grid at 5-km spacing has a maximum planar quantization distance of sqrt(2)/2 * 5 km = 3.536 km, below the endpoint radius; source masking is measured separately by full-frame reachability.
candidate_frame.worldcover_land_filter: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 point classification; permanent water and invalid/no-data candidate cells removed

landcover.tile_boundary_policy: drop a candidate if its 250-m neighbourhood would cross the assigned official 3-degree source tile; no clipped neighbourhood rescue

population_holdout.fold_rule: leave every full population cluster out once; retain every other population as known evidence
population_holdout.population_count_drift_policy: abstain that pair; no threshold, region, species, or identity repair

comparators.nearest_known: ANNULAR_NEAREST_KNOWN full deterministic order on the same fold-specific candidate frame
comparators.spatial_balance: MORTON_DYADIC_COVERAGE_ORDER_V1 full deterministic order on the same fold-specific candidate frame

prefix_curve.selected_count_rule: ceil(fraction * fold candidate count), minimum one when nonempty

outcome.score: binary full-population recovery: at least one selected candidate cell lies within the declared radius of at least one member of the hidden population
outcome.unreachable_full_frame: retain the fold with zero recovery for every method; also report full-frame reachability separately

aggregate_reporting.primary: unweighted mean recovery across all executed folds and all seven frozen prefix fractions at 5 km; compare structural-minus-nearest and structural-minus-spatial-balance
secondary: full-frame recovery ceiling at 5 and 10 km
aggregate_reporting.reason_no_promotion_gate: Only one species per executed structural family is available in this opened development set. Any later promotion requires a new disjoint source-qualified cohort.

source_failure_policy.interpretation: provider/source failure is unavailable evidence, not a negative biological selector result

forbidden: do not retune family formulas, graph radius, grid spacing, prefix fractions, recovery radius, precision rule, population rule, or fixed region after hidden-population scoring
do not fit structural feature weights from these opened populations
do not substitute a new coastal component definition for CIR08 in this v1
do not remove full-frame-unreachable folds from the primary aggregate
do not call this independent confirmation, prospective field validation, occupancy prediction, or field efficiency
do not infer access, route, survey days, money, discoveries per hour, or stopping
